digest.component_or_area: BindingStore persistence and rotation state management
propositions: The legacy inline last_get_pass field must be removed from bindings.json after a successful save, provided all writers have been upgraded to A2-1 or newer.
The save path must persist rotation state (get_rotation.json) before removing inline fields from the binding payload, and only scrub inline values if sidecar persistence succeeds.
When sidecar persistence fails, the primary binding save must succeed and retain the inline last_get_pass as a failure floor for later recovery.
A crash between successful sidecar persist and bindings replace must not lose the maximum rotation timestamp, because it is already durable in the sidecar.
An old-writer followed by new-writer sequence must preserve the chronological maximum of inline and sidecar timestamps, promoting it into get_rotation.json.
